name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: Pressable toggle button and a single or multiple toggle group with default and outline variants, built on Reka UI.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ToggleEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import type { ToggleProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { Toggle, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { toggleVariants } from './index'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<ToggleProps>(), {
  variant: 'default',
  size: 'default',
  disabled: false,
})
const emits = defineEmits<ToggleEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class', 'variant', 'size')
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <Toggle
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="toggle"
    :data-variant="props.variant"
    :data-size="props.size"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn(toggleVariants({ variant: props.variant, size: props.size }), props.class)"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </Toggle>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ToggleGroupRootEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import type { ToggleGroupProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { ToggleGroupRoot, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { provide } from 'vue'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { toggleGroupKey } from './index'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<ToggleGroupProps>(), {
  variant: 'default',
  size: 'default',
  joined: false,
})
const emits = defineEmits<ToggleGroupRootEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class', 'variant', 'size', 'joined')
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)

provide(toggleGroupKey, {
  get variant() { return props.variant },
  get size() { return props.size },
  get joined() { return props.joined },
})
</script>

<template>
  <ToggleGroupRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="toggle-group"
    :data-variant="props.variant"
    :data-size="props.size"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('flex w-fit flex-wrap items-center', props.joined ? 'gap-0' : 'gap-1', props.class)"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </ToggleGroupRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ToggleGroupItemExtraProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { ToggleGroupItem, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { computed, inject } from 'vue'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { toggleGroupKey, toggleVariants } from './index'

const props = defineProps<ToggleGroupItemExtraProps>()

const group = inject(toggleGroupKey, {})
const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class', 'variant', 'size')
const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegatedProps)
const variant = computed(() => props.variant ?? group.variant ?? 'default')
const size = computed(() => props.size ?? group.size ?? 'default')
</script>

<template>
  <ToggleGroupItem
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="toggle-group-item"
    :data-variant="variant"
    :data-size="size"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn(
      toggleVariants({ variant, size }),
      group.joined && 'rounded-none first:rounded-s-md last:rounded-e-md focus-visible:z-10',
      group.joined && variant === 'outline' && 'not-first:-ms-px',
      props.class,
    )"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </ToggleGroupItem>
</template>
